fields.label: Insured person's name
fields.description: Name of the insured person (the policyholder), only if stated in the notes. Often the patient themselves.

fields.label: Sex
fields.description: Patient's sex as M or F, only if stated or unambiguous from the notes

fields.label: Related to an accident
fields.description: Tick only if the notes state the condition resulted from an accident

fields.label: Proposed place of hospitalisation
fields.description: Name and address of the hospital the patient will be admitted to, if stated in the notes

fields.label: Attending physician
fields.description: Attending physician's name, address and telephone, if stated in the notes

fields.label: Reason for hospitalisation / diagnosis
fields.description: Reason for the hospitalisation: clinical symptoms presented and the precise medical diagnosis

fields.label: Proposed operation and treatment
fields.description: Nature of the proposed operation and the treatment programme

fields.label: Additional examinations
fields.description: Nature of any additional examinations to be carried out, if stated in the notes

fields.label: Date of admission
fields.description: Date the patient was or will be admitted (DD/MM/YYYY)

fields.label: Number of days
fields.description: Expected length of stay in days, if stated in the notes

fields.label: Is this an extension?
fields.description: y or n — whether this is an extension of an existing stay. Leave missing unless the notes say.

fields.label: Estimated hospital charges
fields.description: Estimated hospital charges, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Estimated physicians' fees
fields.description: Estimated physicians' fees, only if stated in the notes

fields.label: Other expenses
fields.description: Other estimated expenses, only if stated in the notes
